column1: # Generic OBD-II fault codes (SAE J2012 code numbers) with Scana's own plain-English descriptions.
# Written for Scana (2026-10-16), not copied from SAE text. Check a code against the maker's
# workshop manual before acting on it. Format: CODE<TAB>description. Maker-specific codes
# (P1xxx, B1xxx and so on) belong in a vehicle profile, not here.
# About 360 codes were written one by one. The rest were written from the component and fault
# each code number stands for, checked against the open python-OBD code list
# (github.com/brendan-w/python-OBD, GPL-2.0-or-later), and reworded in Scana's plain style.
# Where that list doesn't say which bank, sensor or wire a code is for, the description says so.
